evidence.title: InjecMEM: Memory Injection Attack on LLM Agent Memory Systems

summary: A new study introduces InjecMEM, a technique that injects malicious data into the external memory modules of large language model agents, allowing attackers to manipulate the agents' behavior and outputs. The findings expose a critical vulnerability in LLM-powered autonomous systems and call for robust memory‑safety safeguards.
title: Researchers Unveil InjecMEM: Memory Injection Attack Targeting LLM Agent Memory Systems
